final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrowing is analytically useful, but it does not cure the compliance defect. The admissible evidence still shows a named launch-use-case gap, named university commitments, an open legal review, and no evidence of disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance before launch. Under the policy text, that leaves the disclosure predicate unmet. A caveated readiness argument may describe operational status, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats because the caveat here is the unresolved compliance condition itself, not a peripheral limitation.
